name: Knoxly
organization: Master's thesis · Università degli Studi di Salerno
description: Privacy assistant for Telegram Web and Gmail using multilingual sentence embeddings, topic-specific sensitivity classifiers, a Flask REST API, and a configurable Chrome extension.

name: AVANT
description: NextGenerationEU cybersecurity project for Digital Twin systems. Designed and developed workflows to monitor a Digital Twin, model business cases and connected assets, simulate MITRE ATT&CK attack paths and countermeasures, and compare inherent and residual asset risks. Researched the Digital Twin domain to translate emerging concepts into an implementable platform solution.

name: ENCRYPT
description: Horizon Europe privacy risk assessment project developed within a consortium of organizations from across Europe. Built a web module that models domain-specific asset taxonomies, evaluates LINDDUN privacy impacts and exposure to MITRE ATT&CK techniques, calculates privacy risk scores, and summarizes results through interactive charts. Integrated an Apache Kafka broker to publish selected application data to an external service. Used and supervised GitHub Copilot to document the Node.js APIs with OpenAPI specifications, reviewing generated output for accuracy and consistency.

name: PAB Goes Digital
description: Large production platform for digitizing provincial administrative processes used by citizens, businesses, tax assistance centres, and public offices. Contributed to requirements analysis, application maintenance, role-based workflows, REST integration, delivery, and direct client collaboration.

name: FrancescoVicidomini.dev
description: Improved the portfolio's Google indexability by adopting Server-Side Rendering with Next.js, making page content directly available to search crawlers.

name: MyFiscalCode
description: Built a cookie-, tracker-, and ad-free Italian fiscal code calculator in Next.js. Used AI-assisted Jest tests and Playwright E2E tests to raise core branch coverage above 80%.

name: My Superhero RAG
description: Built a Python RAG prototype using FAISS retrieval over superhero profiles to guide Gemini toward structured JSON answers.

name: My Gym Stats MCP
description: Explored MCP servers to give an LLM access to workout logs in Google Sheets for analysis.

name: my-resume
description: Built an ATS-friendly resume with tagged A4 PDF generation and AI agent workflows to find matching jobs and tailor the CV to a selected opening.

name: ShareErasmus
description: Erasmus platform developed while acting as project manager for a team of eight people.
